Name: Serpent’s Stone
Description: The Serpent's Stone, the stone of Zoheleth, stood by En-rogel, where Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fat cattle and invited his brothers and the king's servants while claiming the throne.
BiblicalSignificance: The stone marks Adonijah's rival feast on the edge of Jerusalem, held while David still lived and Solomon's anointing was yet to come.
RelatedPeople: Adonijah, Son of Haggith; King David
